finding.headline: "The First 14 Days Home Operating System (No Village Edition) for the African C-section mom healing alone with a newborn."
finding.problem: Major abdominal surgery + 24/7 newborn care + no omugwo/live-in help + a working partner = a mom who cannot get out of bed, feed, or run her home without shame or reinjury. Hospital discharge assumes a village she doesn't have.
